description: EXIT PERFORM [CYCLE] (ISO §2023:14.9.14.2 Format 3 / §2023:14.9.14.4 GR5a) — a COBOL-2002 structured-procedure exit leaving (or cycling) the most closely preceding inline PERFORM. CYCLE is confined to an inline PERFORM by §2023:14.9.14.3 SR8 and rides the same gate. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the ANSI X3.23-1985 Nucleus EXIT statement's general format is the bare word `EXIT` (§1985:VI.6.14.2), and §1985:VI.6.14.3 SR1 reads 'The EXIT statement must appear only in a sentence by itself and comprise the only sentence in the paragraph' (§1985:VI.6.14.4 GR1: 'An EXIT statement serves only to enable the user to assign a procedure-name to a given point in a program'); its one other EXIT is the Inter-Program Communication EXIT PROGRAM (§1985:X.5.4.1: 'The EXIT PROGRAM statement marks the logical end of a called program'). §2002:14.8.13 adds Format 5 `EXIT PERFORM [ CYCLE ]` and Format 6 `EXIT { PARAGRAPH | SECTION }`: 'The EXIT PERFORM statement provides a means of exiting an inline PERFORM (with or without returning to any specified test)' and 'The EXIT PARAGRAPH and EXIT SECTION statements provide a means of exiting a structured procedure without executing any of the following statements within the procedure', and §2002:F.2 states the change, its item 49: 'The ability to immediately exit an inline PERFORM statement, a paragraph, or a section has been added.' §2002:14.8.13.3 GR9 'The execution of an EXIT PERFORM statement without the CYCLE phrase causes control to be passed to an implicit CONTINUE statement immediately following the END-PERFORM phrase' that matches the innermost unterminated inline PERFORM, GR10 its CYCLE twin ('immediately preceding the END-PERFORM phrase'), SR10 'The EXIT PERFORM statement may be specified only in an inline PERFORM statement'. §2014:14.9.13.3 GR9 prints the 2002 rule unchanged, so 2014 = 2023.
vcr: 2002 introduction (§2002:14.8.13 Format 5; §2002:F.2 item 49; no VCR row)

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMEXPERF.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 N PIC 9 VALUE 0.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    PERFORM UNTIL N > 5
        ADD 1 TO N
        IF N = 3 EXIT PERFORM END-IF
    END-PERFORM.
    DISPLAY N.
    STOP RUN.
